Our medical team work round the clock to bring you the most effective treatments available in the UK.
Now hair loss is treatable. There are clinically proven treatments effective in 9/10 men. And we have them all here.
Low mood? Low energy? Low libido? Testosterone levels could be to blame, get a diagnosis and life-changing treatment with Manual.
Erectile dysfunction (ED) happens to a lot of us. We can help you figure out why. And offer a number of treatments that can help too.
Dr. Earim Chaudry, Chief Medical Officer
“These are the most effective, proven treatments available in the UK.”
Enabling the mission of revolutionising how men approach health, they are at the core of the men’s wellness platform.

The convenience and cost are unbeatable. Having used the Belgravia Centre for years, I realise just how much better the cost and service can be.

I think all the help that I wanted is exactly what you’ve delivered so far. I am only 2 days into it so I don’t know how the product is going to turn out but I feel confident that I am in good hands .
